title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity | TechCrunch
summary: French AI company Mistral has released the weights for its trillion-parameter open source AI model Mistral Large 4 (ML4), allowing businesses and governments to download and deploy the system themselves.
